messages:
Asha: Noticed p95 for /v1/generate jumped ~150ms in prod-eu after we changed routing weights. No deploy. Screenshot: https://console.redwood/shot2.png
ben: Likely merge artifact. Endpoint-level percentiles are merged across routes (we tdigest-merge by default). Weight shifts can change aggregate pctl.
tom: Agree. Our alerts are on endpoint p95 which makes rollouts noisy. We should expose route provenance and add a console hint.
ui-bot: UI suggestion: small inline pill: "samples: dedicated 71%" and a "breakdown" button that switches the chart to per-route percentiles.
metrics-bot: alert: p95 threshold crossed for /v1/generate (prod-eu) at 2024-08-01T09:14:12Z.
Asha: Action items: (1) ben add `merge_mode` + `provenance=true` to metrics API, (2) tom update alerting playbook to prefer route-level SLOs or sample-count guards, (3) ui-bot/lisa add pill + breakdown toggle as console canary. Will coord PRs.
